description: This PHP script acts as a sample client for interacting with the TestLink API, specifically to retrieve test cases for a given test suite. It sets up API request parameters, creates a client object, and runs multiple tests with different parameters.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: A class representing the XML-RPC client used to communicate with the TestLink API.

methods.name: show_api_db_sample_msg
methods.description: Displays a sample message related to the API database sample.

methods.name: runTest
methods.description: Executes an API test call with the specified client, method, and arguments.
